scientific_integrity: Proof supplied for arbitrary finite cores and positive clique sizes. The program exhaustively verifies only stated finite test cases. Independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Bias expansion fixes the finite core H; no uniform error as the core size grows, no polynomial-time evaluation guarantee, no universal exact-uniformity classification, and no conclusive bibliographic priority claim.
title: Random-greedy laws and sharp bias for clique coronas
